quote: Pegasus (or Pegasos) is a winged-horse from Greek mythology which was fathered by Poseidon and was born from the severed neck of the gorgon Medusa, slain by Perseus.

statement.id: Pegasus adalah kuda bersayap mitologi Yunani, putra Poseidon yang muncul ketika Perseus memenggal Medusa.
statement.en: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, fathered by Poseidon and born when Perseus beheaded Medusa.

quote: PEGASOS (Pegasus) was an immortal, winged horse which sprang from the neck of the beheaded Gorgon Medousa (Medusa).

statement.id: Pegasus adalah kuda bersayap abadi yang muncul dari leher Medusa.
statement.en: Pegasus is an immortal winged horse that emerged from Medusa's neck.

quote: Taming the horse with the help of Athena, Bellerophon rode (and flew) Pegasus and managed to kill the monstrous Chimaera with his spear.

statement.id: Bellerophon menjinakkan Pegasus dengan bantuan Athena dan menungganginya untuk mengalahkan Chimaera.
statement.en: With Athena's help, Bellerophon tamed Pegasus and rode him against the Chimaera.

quote: However, becoming rather boastful and thinking he could fly high enough on his winged steed to take his place amongst the immortal gods, Bellerophon was thrown by Pegasus and fell unceremoniously back to earth.

statement.id: Pegasus menjatuhkan Bellerophon ketika sang pahlawan mencoba terbang ke tempat para dewa.
statement.en: Pegasus threw Bellerophon when the hero tried to fly to the gods.

quote: According to Hesiod in his Theogony, Pegasus also brought Zeus his thunder and lightning whenever needed.

statement.id: Dalam Theogony karya Hesiod, Pegasus membawa petir untuk Zeus.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony, Pegasus brought thunder and lightning to Zeus.

quote: Pegasus is also credited with creating a number of springs with a stamp of his hoof. Most famous of these were the Hippocrene spring on Mt. Helicon

statement.id: Hentakan kaki Pegasus dipercaya menciptakan mata air Hippocrene di Gunung Helicon.
statement.en: Pegasus's hoofstamp was credited with creating the Hippocrene spring on Mount Helicon.

quote: Pegasos was commemorated amongst the stars as the constellation of the same name.

statement.id: Pegasus dikenang sebagai rasi bintang yang memakai namanya.
statement.en: Pegasus was commemorated as the constellation of the same name.

quote: Pegasus appeared on Greek pottery, the earliest being Corinthian wares from the 7th century BCE. Pegasus was also a popular design on coins, in particular from Corinth from the 6th century BCE.

statement.id: Pegasus muncul pada tembikar dan koin Yunani kuno.
statement.en: Pegasus appeared on ancient Greek pottery and coins.

quote: At the same time and in the same way, Chryasor was also born.

statement.id: Pada saat yang sama dan dengan cara yang sama, Chrysaor (ditulis Chryasor dalam sumber) juga lahir.
statement.en: At the same time and in the same way, Chrysaor (spelled Chryasor in the source) was also born.

quote: Poseidon gave Pegasus to his son Bellerophon who put Pegasus to good use in his famous battle with the Chimaera.

statement.id: Poseidon memberikan Pegasus kepada putranya, Bellerophon, yang memanfaatkannya dalam pertempuran terkenal melawan Chimaera.
statement.en: Poseidon gave Pegasus to his son Bellerophon, who put Pegasus to good use in his famous battle with the Chimaera.

quote: To aid him in this task, Bellerophon was fortunate to have at his disposal Pegasus. In some accounts he found the horse at the fountain of Pirene near Corinth, and Hesiod suggests this fact explains the name Pegasus, derived from 'water'- pēgē.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian kisah Bellerophon menemukan kuda itu di mata air Pirene dekat Corinth, dan Hesiod menyiratkan hal ini menjelaskan nama Pegasus, yang diturunkan dari pēgē ('air').
statement.en: In some accounts Bellerophon found the horse at the fountain of Pirene near Corinth, and Hesiod suggests this explains the name Pegasus, derived from pēgē ('water').

quote: Meanwhile, Pegasus kept on going and on reaching Mt. Olympus, he was given to Eos who was responsible for bringing Dawn across the sky each day.

statement.id: Pegasus terus terbang dan setibanya di Gunung Olympus ia diserahkan kepada Eos, yang bertugas membawa fajar melintasi langit setiap hari.
statement.en: Pegasus flew on and, on reaching Mt. Olympus, was given to Eos, who was responsible for bringing Dawn across the sky each day.

quote: A famous representation in sculpture is from the pediment of the Temple of Artemis on Corcyra (c. 580 BCE).

statement.id: Salah satu penggambaran terkenal dalam seni pahat berasal dari pedimen Kuil Artemis di Corcyra (sekitar 580 SM).
statement.en: A famous sculptural representation comes from the pediment of the Temple of Artemis on Corcyra (c. 580 BCE).

quote: The Bellerophon and Pegasus myth was also a popular subject in Roman art - especially engraved semi-precious stone cameos and floor mosaics - where the horse became symbolic of immortality.

statement.id: Mitos Bellerophon dan Pegasus juga populer dalam seni Romawi, terutama kamei batu semimulia dan mozaik lantai, tempat kuda itu menjadi lambang keabadian.
statement.en: The Bellerophon and Pegasus myth was also popular in Roman art, especially engraved semi-precious stone cameos and floor mosaics, where the horse became symbolic of immortality.

quote: Pegasos' name means either "of the spring" from the Greek word ... "sprung forth" from the word ... The first alludes to the steed's connection with various springs, and the latter to its birth from the Gorgon's neck.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, nama Pegasos berarti 'dari mata air' atau 'memancar keluar'; yang pertama merujuk pada kaitan kuda itu dengan berbagai mata air, yang kedua pada kelahirannya dari leher Gorgon.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Pegasos' name means either 'of the spring' or 'sprung forth'; the first alludes to the steed's link with various springs, the second to its birth from the Gorgon's neck.

quote: Later the hero attempted to fly to heaven but Zeus caused the horse to buck throwing him back down to earth in disgrace. Pegasos winged his way on to Olympos where he became the thunderbolt-bearer of Zeus.

statement.id: Bellerophon kemudian mencoba terbang ke surga, tetapi Zeus membuat kuda itu meronta sehingga sang pahlawan terlempar ke bumi; Pegasos terbang ke Olympos dan menjadi pembawa petir Zeus.
statement.en: Later the hero tried to fly to heaven, but Zeus made the horse buck and throw him back to earth; Pegasos flew on to Olympos and became Zeus's thunderbolt-bearer.

quote: Pegasos was commemorated amongst the stars as the constellation of the same name. Its rising marks the arrival of spring and, in Greece, of seasonal thunderstorms.

statement.id: Terbitnya rasi bintang Pegasus menandai datangnya musim semi dan, di Yunani, badai petir musiman.
statement.en: The rising of the Pegasus constellation marks the arrival of spring and, in Greece, of seasonal thunderstorms.

quote: According to this view, which is apparently the most ancient, Pegasus was the thundering horse of Zeus; but later writers describe him as the horse of Eos

statement.id: Menurut pandangan yang tampaknya paling kuno, Pegasus adalah kuda petir milik Zeus, sedangkan penulis yang lebih belakangan menyebutnya kuda Eos.
statement.en: On the view that seems the most ancient, Pegasus was the thundering horse of Zeus, whereas later writers describe him as the horse of Eos.

quote: The latter advised him to spend a night in the temple of Athena, and, as Bellerophon was sleeping, the goddess appeared to him in a dream, commanding him to sacrifice to Poseidon, and gave him a golden bridle.

statement.id: Menurut salah satu kisah, Athena menampakkan diri kepada Bellerophon dalam mimpi, memerintahkannya berkurban kepada Poseidon, dan memberinya kekang emas.
statement.en: In one account Athena appeared to Bellerophon in a dream, told him to sacrifice to Poseidon, and gave him a golden bridle.

quote: According to some Athena herself tamed and bridled Pegasus, and surrendered him to Bellerophon

statement.id: Menurut sebagian kisah, Athena sendiri yang menjinakkan dan memasang kekang pada Pegasus lalu menyerahkannya kepada Bellerophon.
statement.en: According to some accounts, Athena herself tamed and bridled Pegasus and handed him over to Bellerophon.

quote: After he had conquered the Chimaera ... he endeavoured to rise up to heaven with his winged horse, but fell down upon the earth, either from fear or from giddiness, or being thrown off by Pegasus, who was rendered furious by a gad-fly which Zeus had sent.

statement.id: Setelah menaklukkan Chimaera, ia berusaha naik ke surga dengan kuda bersayapnya tetapi jatuh ke bumi, entah karena takut atau pusing, entah karena dilempar Pegasus yang dibuat murka oleh seekor lalat pengganggu kiriman Zeus.
statement.en: After conquering the Chimaera, he tried to rise to heaven on his winged horse but fell to earth, whether from fear or giddiness or because Pegasus, enraged by a gad-fly Zeus had sent, threw him.

quote: Pegasus lastly was also regarded as the horse of the Muses, and in this capacity he is more celebrated in modern times than he ever was in antiquity ; for with the ancients he had no connection with the Muses, except that by his hoof he called forth the inspiring well Hippocrene.

statement.id: Pegasus belakangan juga dianggap kuda para Muse; dalam peran ini ia lebih terkenal di zaman modern daripada di masa kuno, sebab bagi orang kuno hubungannya dengan para Muse hanya lewat hentakan kukunya yang memunculkan mata air Hippocrene.
statement.en: Pegasus was also later regarded as the horse of the Muses; in this role he is more celebrated in modern times than in antiquity, since for the ancients his only link to the Muses was that his hoof called forth the Hippocrene well.

quote: But when Perseus had cut off the head of Medousa (Medusa) there sprang from her blood stout-hearted Khrysaor (Chrysaor) and the horse Pegasos so named from the springs (pegai) of Okeanos (Oceanus), where he was born.
locator: Classical literature quotes: The Birth of Pegasus

statement.id: Hesiod, Theogony: setelah Perseus memenggal kepala Medusa, Khrysaor dan kuda Pegasos melompat dari darahnya; Pegasos dinamai dari mata air (pegai) Okeanos tempat ia lahir.
statement.en: Hesiod, Theogony: when Perseus cut off Medusa's head, Khrysaor and the horse Pegasos sprang from her blood; Pegasos was named after the springs (pegai) of Okeanos where he was born.

quote: Hesiod, Theogony 280 ff (trans. Evelyn-White) (Greek epic C8th or C7th B.C.)
locator: Classical literature quotes: The Birth of Pegasus

statement.id: Theoi menggolongkan Theogony karya Hesiod, yang memuat kisah kelahiran Pegasos, sebagai epos Yunani abad ke-8 atau ke-7 SM.
statement.en: Theoi classes Hesiod's Theogony, which contains the account of Pegasos's birth, as Greek epic of the 8th or 7th century BCE.

quote: [1.1] POSEIDON & MEDOUSA (Hesiod Theogony 278, Apollodorus 2.32 & 2.42, Hyginus Fabulae 151 & Astronomica 2.18, Ovid Metamorphoses 4.781 & 6.119)

statement.id: Theoi mencatat Poseidon dan Medousa sebagai orang tua Pegasos menurut Hesiod, Apollodorus, Hyginus, dan Ovid.
statement.en: Theoi lists Poseidon and Medousa as Pegasos's parents according to Hesiod, Apollodorus, Hyginus, and Ovid.

quote: [1.2] MEDOUSA (Pindar Olympian Ode, Nonnus Dionysiaca 24.270)

statement.id: Theoi juga mencatat tradisi (Pindar, Nonnus) yang hanya menyebut Medousa sebagai orang tua Pegasos.
statement.en: Theoi also records a tradition (Pindar, Nonnus) naming only Medousa as Pegasos's parent.

quote: his father [Poseidon] gave him Pegasos who would bear him most swiftly on his wings, and flew unwearying everywhere over the earth
locator: Classical literature quotes: Pegasus, Bellerophon & the Chimera

statement.id: Hesiod (Catalogues of Women): ayah Bellerophon, Poseidon, memberinya Pegasos yang membawanya secepat kilat dengan sayapnya dan terbang tak kenal lelah ke mana-mana di bumi.
statement.en: Hesiod (Catalogues of Women): Bellerophon's father Poseidon gave him Pegasos, who bore him swiftly on his wings and flew unwearying everywhere over the earth.

quote: But Khimaira (Chimera) was killed by Pegasos and gallant Bellerophon.
locator: Classical literature quotes: Pegasus, Bellerophon & the Chimera

statement.id: Hesiod, Theogony: Khimaira dibunuh oleh Pegasos dan Bellerophon yang gagah berani.
statement.en: Hesiod, Theogony: Khimaira (Chimera) was killed by Pegasos and gallant Bellerophon.

quote: seeking to yoke the snake-haired Gorgo's offspring, Pegasos. Till Pallas [Athena], goddess maid, brought him the bridle and golden headband
locator: Classical literature quotes: Pegasus, Bellerophon & the Chimera

statement.id: Pindar: Bellerophon lama berusaha mengekang Pegasos, anak Gorgo berambut ular, sampai Pallas (Athena) membawakan kekang dan ikat kepala emas.
statement.en: Pindar: Bellerophon long strove to yoke Pegasos, the snake-haired Gorgo's offspring, until Pallas (Athena) brought him the bridle and golden headband.

quote: When the Mousai (Muses) sang, heaven, the stars, the sea and rivers stood still, while Mount Helikon (Helicon), beguiled by the pleasure of it all, swelled skyward till, by the will of Poseidon, Pegasos checked it by striking the summit with his hoof.
locator: Classical literature quotes: Pegasus & the Spring of Hippocrene

statement.id: Antoninus Liberalis: Gunung Helikon, terpikat kenikmatan nyanyian para Muse, membengkak ke langit sampai Pegasos, atas kehendak Poseidon, menghentikannya dengan menghentak puncaknya.
statement.en: Antoninus Liberalis: Mount Helikon, beguiled by the pleasure of the Muses' song, swelled skyward until Pegasos, by Poseidon's will, checked it by striking the summit with his hoof.

quote: It was made, they say, by [Pegasos] the horse of Bellerophon striking the ground with this hoof.
locator: Classical literature quotes: Pegasus & the Spring of Hippocrene

statement.id: Pausanias: Hippokrene, kata orang, dibuat oleh Pegasos, kuda Bellerophon, yang menghentak tanah dengan kukunya.
statement.en: Pausanias: Hippokrene was made, they say, by Pegasos, the horse of Bellerophon, striking the ground with his hoof.

quote: A proposed etymology of the name is Luwian pihassas 'lightning', and Pihassassi, a local Luwian-Hittite name in southern Cilicia of a weather deity associated with thunder and lightning.

statement.id: Salah satu etimologi yang diusulkan untuk nama itu adalah kata Luwian pihassas ('kilat') dan Pihassassi, nama Luwian-Het setempat di Kilikia selatan untuk dewa cuaca yang dikaitkan dengan guntur dan kilat.
statement.en: One proposed etymology of the name is Luwian pihassas 'lightning' and Pihassassi, a local Luwian-Hittite name in southern Cilicia for a weather deity associated with thunder and lightning.

quote: That interpretation was first suggested in 1952 and remains widely accepted ... but Robin Lane Fox (2009) has criticized it as implausible.

statement.id: Tafsiran Luwian itu pertama kali diajukan pada 1952 dan masih diterima luas, tetapi Robin Lane Fox (2009) mengkritiknya sebagai tidak masuk akal.
statement.en: The Luwian interpretation was first suggested in 1952 and remains widely accepted, but Robin Lane Fox (2009) has criticized it as implausible.

quote: During World War II, the silhouetted image of Bellerophon the warrior, mounted on the winged Pegasus, was adopted by the United Kingdom's newly raised parachute troops in 1941 as their upper sleeve insignia.
locator: In heraldry / World War II emblem

statement.id: Selama Perang Dunia II, siluet Bellerophon yang menunggang Pegasus bersayap diadopsi pasukan penerjun payung Inggris yang baru dibentuk pada 1941 sebagai lambang lengan atas.
statement.en: During World War II the silhouette of Bellerophon mounted on the winged Pegasus was adopted in 1941 by the United Kingdom's newly raised parachute troops as their upper-sleeve insignia.

quote: The Pegasus has been a symbol of Tuscany ever since Benvenuto Cellini incorporated it in a coin made in 1537 to honor Cardinal Pietro Bembo.

statement.id: Pegasus menjadi simbol Toskana sejak Benvenuto Cellini memasukkannya pada koin tahun 1537 untuk menghormati Kardinal Pietro Bembo.
statement.en: Pegasus has been a symbol of Tuscany since Benvenuto Cellini included it on a coin of 1537 honoring Cardinal Pietro Bembo.
